Situation update — last 2 hours

  • Airspace & flights: Regional airspace disrupted. Flight scans show snapshots of 672 aircraft (including 1 C‑130) and later 344 aircraft. Airports in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria and Lebanon and Jordan reported closed.
  • Diplomacy / pause: US President announced a SECOND pause on strikes targeting Iranian energy (10 days; deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an Iranian request and ongoing talks. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating.
  • Strait of Hormuz: US reportedly offered Iran access to frozen funds in return for guaranteed free passage through the Strait (TASS). Tactical note: financial leverage used to secure shipping corridors.
  • Northern border: Hezbollah-related activity continues daily (ongoing exchanges). No single major change reported in the last two hours.
  • Military messaging & funding: Defense Minister Katz and IDF Chief Zamir marked 1,000 days since Oct 7, issued warnings toward Iran. Finance and Defense reached a deal to add NIS 15 billion to the IDF budget.
  • Domestic / security incidents: Canada synagogue firebomber reportedly motivated by drugs, promised $15,000 — note for diaspora-terror monitoring.
  • Cyber: One high-severity cyber incident detected in the last two hours. Investigation ongoing.
  • International posture: Turkey escalatory rhetoric: called Israel “a problem for the whole world” (TASS).
  • 🟢 Good News: Second pause announced; additional NIS 15bn approved for IDF readiness.
  • Bottom line: Escalating

  • דיפלומטיה / הפסקה: הנשיא האמריקאי הכריז על הפסקה שנייה במתקפות על אנרגיה באיראן (10 ימים; מועד סיום 6.4.2026 20:00 ET), בטענה לבקשת איראן ודיאלוג מתקדם. איראן מכחישה שיחות ישירות. פקיסטן מתווכת.
  • מיצרי הורמוז: ארה"ב הציעה גישה למשאבים קפואים בתמורה להבטחת מעבר חופשי במיצר (TASS). הקשר טקטי: שימוש בלחץ כלכלי כדי להבטיח נתיבי סחר.
  • גבול הצפון: פעילות חסן־חיזבאללה נמשכת יומית. לא דווח על אירוע בולט בשעתיים האחרונות.
  • הודעה צבאית ומימון: שר הביטחון כץ ורמטכ"ל זמיר ציינו 1,000 ימים מאז 7.10 ואיימו כלפי איראן. הושג סיכום להעברת עוד 15 מיליארד ש"ח לצה"ל.
  • ביטחון פנים: מבצע ההצתה בבית כנסת בקנדה כנראה מונע על ידי סמים; הובטחה לו תמורה כספית. רלוונטי למעקב הפרוסה.
  • סייבר: אירוע סייבר בחומרה גבוהה—בטיחון חקירה.
  • מעמד בינלאומי: טורקיה התבטאה בחריפות וקראה: "ישראל בעיה לעולם" (TASS).
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: הוכרזה הפסקה שנייה; אישור תוספת של 15 מיליארד ש"ח לחירום צה"ל.
  • שורה תחתונה: Escalating

Situation — Day 27

  • Pause & Diplomacy: US President announced a 10-day SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET). White House says talks "going very well." Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating.
  • Context: First pause (5 days, Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr. Pause is fragile.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah active daily. Israeli forces report persistent rocket/missile launches from Lebanon sectors.
  • Hormuz & Maritime: Iran allows Strait passage to Russia, India, China while blocking others. TASS reports US offered Iran access to frozen funds in exchange for free passage.
  • Airspace & Flights: Regional airports closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Flight scans show reduced commercial traffic and intermittent military flights (C-130, RCH260/264).
  • Cyber: Two incidents in last 6 hours — one CRITICAL, one HIGH. Expect continued cyber probing and intermittent outages.
  • Domestic Israeli: Government approved extra NIS 15 billion for the IDF. IDF warns combat force nearing breaking point without more manpower. Disciplinary action ordered for soldiers who filmed/bound a detainee.
  • Iran internal: Iran preparing week-long mass mourning for slain Supreme Leader; delegations (including Pakistan, India) attending funerals.
  • International moves: Turkey escalates rhetoric; Kuwait raising crude output after US‑Iran arrangements. Russia signals willingness to assist mediation.
  • 🟢 Good News: Temporary US pause announced; Israel secured an additional NIS 15 billion for the IDF.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating — high risk of renewed strikes despite the pause.

  • Airspace & flights: Major regional airports closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Military flights recorded (C‑130, ISR assets). Civil traffic sharply reduced.
  • Strait of Hormuz: Iran allowing passage for Russia, India, China; blocking others. US reportedly offered Iran access to frozen funds in exchange for free passage.
  • Northern border (Hezbollah): Daily rocket/missile exchanges into northern Israel. Persistent low‑to‑medium intensity strikes and counterfire.
  • Diplomacy & regional moves: Pakistan PM to attend Khamenei funeral. Russia signals readiness to assist talks. India and Kuwait send envoys; Kuwait boosting June crude output after U.S.‑Iran arrangements.
  • Home front: Finance and Defense agreed an extra NIS 15 billion for the IDF. IDF warns manpower strain continues.
  • Cyber: Recent high/critical cyber incidents reported.
  • 🟢 Good News: 10‑day energy pause announced; IDF received NIS 15B funding.
  • Bottom line: Escalating.

Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active strikes: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran continue. Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas launch missiles/rockets into Israel. First pause was violated when US/Israeli jets hit Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Pause update: Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes for 10 days (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an "Iranian government request" and talks "going very well." Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah conducts daily strikes and launches. IDF conducts counter-strikes across Lebanon. Front remains active and attritional.
  • Strait of Hormuz: Iran allows passage for friendly states (Russia, India, China) and blocks others. US reportedly offered access to frozen funds in exchange for free passage.
  • Airspace & transport: Major regional airports closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Flight scans show sustained military air traffic.
  • Diplomacy & leadership: Iran preparing week-long mass mourning and funeral for Supreme Leader; foreign delegations (including Pakistan, India, Russia) to attend — raises concentration risk and diplomatic activity.
  • Cyber: Multiple incidents reported; at least one critical-high severity event in last 48 hrs.
  • Domestic military strain: Government approved additional NIS 15 billion for IDF; commanders warn manpower limits.
  • International moves: Pakistan actively mediating; Russia offers assistance in US–Iran talks; Turkey increases rhetorical pressure on Israel.
  • 🟢 Good News: Second pause announced (temporary window for diplomacy); Pakistan mediation continues; extra IDF funding approved.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating

  • סייבר: אירועים מרובים; דווח על לפחות אירוע קריטי-גבוה ב־48 השעות האחרונות.
